invariants.rationale: The array 'frameTiles' is dereferenced in the method, so it must not be null.
The index into the frameTiles array must be non-negative for valid array access.
To avoid ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, 'getCurrentFrameIndex()' must be less than 'frameTiles.length'.
Array 'frameTiles' must contain at least one element to be a valid source of tiles.
